findings.state_law: Gov. Code § 66315: no owner-occupancy requirement may be imposed on ADUs (narrow exception: separate-conveyance sales under § 66341(c)(3)). JADUs with shared sanitation are a lawful exception (§ 66333(b)).

findings.title: Height cap below state-mandated allowances
findings.excerpt: ween the detached ADU and the primary dwelling shall be as per California Residential Code. 4. Height. A detached ADU shall not exceed sixteen feet in height, except in the following cases: a. A height of eighteen feet is permitted when an ADU is located within one
findings.state_law: Gov. Code § 66321(b)(4): 16 ft is the base for detached ADUs. A detached ADU must be allowed 18 ft near a qualifying major transit stop / high-quality transit corridor; that transit branch also allows 2 additional ft for an aligned roof pitch. A separate 18-ft branch applies on a lot with an existing or proposed multistory multifamily dwelling. Attached ADUs must be allowed up to 25 ft or the primary-dwelling zoning limit, whichever is lower.
findings.hcd_precedent: HCD findings letter to County of Santa Clara, June 24, 2025, ADU Finding 6 (Height).
